results.input: What did De Guiche do with the white scarf you brought back to him?
results.reply: I brought him that scrap of white linen from the very brink of the stream, under the very noses of the Spaniards who would have shot it from me had they guessed its worth — and what did he do with it? Then he came down and declared it was a false Spanish spy, extremely useful to his ends: the news the enemy would carry back would be the news he chose to give them.
